text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps spurred by Symboli Rudolf becoming 
an "Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume," 
Sirius Symboli began to train with even 
greater ferocity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To Sirius Symboli, she seemed to be a 
close companion with whom she once ran and 
shared her dreams, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, it seemed their 
relationship had turned sour in the 
present day.
